summary: A unique blend of roguelike, deckbuilder, and dungeon crawler mechanics.
description:
Use a claw machine to grab weapons, shields, and items as you navigate the dungeon packed with enemies and treasures. Get ready for a thrilling journey where your strategy and skill will be tested!

FEATURES:
- Unique Claw Machine Mechanic: Control a real-time claw machine to snatch weapons, shields, and items from the claw machine. Every grab counts, so plan your strategy and defeat enemies with precision.
- Roguelike Dungeon Exploration: Traverse procedurally generated dungeons that change with every run, offering new challenges, enemies, and treasures every time you play.
- Innovative Deckbuilding Strategy: Collect and upgrade your item pool with powerful weapons, items, and trinkets. With countless combinations, create your ultimate strategy to conquer the dungeons.
- Epic Boss Battles: Engage in intense boss battles and unlock special perks aka paws with every victory.
- Endless mode: Even after beating the dungeon boss, the run doesn’t end, but can go on forever. How deep into the dungeon can you venture?
- 4 Difficulty Modes: Beat the dungeon in normal, hard, harder and nightmare mode.
- Unique Characters: Choose from multiple heroes, each with their own unique abilities and playstyles. Discover the best combinations to suit your dungeon-crawling strategy.
- Engaging Storyline: The evil dungeon lord has stolen your rabbit paw and replaced it with a rusty claw. Fight your way through the dungeon to reclaim your lost limb and fortune!
- Stunning Art & Sound: Immerse yourself in the colorful, hand-drawn world of Dungeon Clawler with its dynamic soundtrack and beautifully crafted visuals.

WHY PLAY DUNGEON CLAWLER?
Dungeon Clawler brings together the strategic depth of deckbuilders with the thrilling unpredictability of roguelike dungeon crawlers and the fun of a claw machine mechanic. Each run offers something new, with endless strategies to discover and enemies to defeat. If you're seeking a fresh deck-builder gameplay with infinite replayability, this is the game for you.

EARLY ACCESS: HELP SHAPE THE FUTURE!
Dungeon Clawler is currently in Early Access, and we're committed to making it even better with your feedback! Expect frequent updates, new content, and improvements as we continue to enhance the game. By joining now, you can help shape the future of Dungeon Clawler and be part of our growing community.

JOIN THE ADVENTURE TODAY!
Download Dungeon Clawler now and begin your journey through ever-changing dungeons. Can you master the claw and reclaim your paw? The dungeon awaits!

ABOUT STRAY FAWN
We are an indie game development studio from Zurich, Switzerland. Dungeon Clawler is our fourth game and highly appreciate your support!
